architectures.identity: A, B, C share ONE underlying decision (same names, same base weights) and D, E, F share ONE; the six differ only along the two registered axes

cashYield.accrual: (1 + rate/100) ** (calendar days between the two sessions / 365) - 1, on the primary path's cash weight at the start of the session
cashYield.changes: ONLY the return earned by residual cash
cashYield.floorReason: the source supports no negative investable rate
cashYield.lag: the rate in force on the PREVIOUS session's calendar date applies to the return earned between the previous and this session's close
cashYield.meaning: Bank of Korea base rate, step function of its dated decision history (event date = first calendar day the rate applies)

notUsed.ECOS: an item code is never guessed and the repository's ECOS fetch layer does not exist

bands.source: inherited unchanged from the sealed kr-market-risk-model-v1 nomination; none is invented or tuned here

finalArchitecture.meaning: a DEVELOPMENT architecture to record prospectively; never validation, never production
finalArchitecture.rule: assembled mechanically: industry supported -> I+S else S; then the supported market candidate on that portfolio else none

industryLayer.DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED: primary IMPROVES and no context pair is WORSE
industryLayer.primary: I+S vs S under market OFF (D vs A)

marketLayer.DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED: primary pair on the final underlying portfolio IMPROVES and the same overlay is not WORSE on the other portfolio
marketLayer.c1VsC0: recorded beside; C1 replaces C0 only when BOTH are supported and C1 vs C0 IMPROVES
marketLayer.judged: C0 and C1 SEPARATELY, each on the SAME underlying portfolio without the overlay (B vs A, C vs A, E vs D, F vs D)
marketLayer.justification: return participation lost is justified only while it stays inside the non-inferiority band; a larger loss bought with a larger drawdown reduction is a risk-preference choice and is reported as a trade-off

pairRule.TRADE_OFF: fails non-inferiority on one axis but gains meaningfully on the other: a risk-preference choice this study does not make
pairRule.meaningfulGain: return >= base + 0.50 pp (efficiency) OR |MDD| <= 0.90 x base's (protection)
pairRule.nonInferior: return >= base - 0.50 pp AND |MDD| <= 1.10 x base's

developmentStatement: This integrated architecture is built from three sealed, outcome-exposed component studies (market risk model, industry anatomy, stock within-industry anatomy) on KR history that is already outcome-exposed. Every historical number it produces is DEVELOPMENT evidence for choosing an architecture to record prospectively; it has no prospective validity and validates nothing.

governance.afterAnUnfavourableResult: no v1.1, no threshold sweep, no new factor blend, no new market rule, no top-k search, no cap or cost change
governance.defaultNextStep: prospective receipts of all six target portfolios

industryLayer.cohort: the sealed anatomy's FULL cohort (no mega-cap exclusion), frozen at the signal date

combinedScore.rule: 50% STOCK_SCORE + 50% INDUSTRY_SCORE of the stock's industry, fixed and untuned; requires both

features.BREADTH_ABOVE_MA_126: share of the industry's members above their own 126-session moving average (same function)
features.REL_MOM_126: cap-weighted trailing-126-session return of the industry minus the benchmark's (kr_industry_anatomy.industry_features)

industryScore.rule: 50% cross-industry average-rank percentile of REL_MOM_126 + 50% of BREADTH_ABOVE_MA_126; BOTH required; computed over the eligible industries (at least 5 classified members) with both finite on that date

industryLayer.rankabilityRule: every rebalance anchor must rank at least the minimum industries, otherwise the run stops BEFORE the lock
industryLayer.role: OPTIONAL: when ON it re-orders eligible stocks by the state of their industry; when OFF it contributes exactly zero

input.downloadRule: execution downloads this exact artifact (name, run id, artifact id and archive digest checked through the Actions API) and verifies the input identity before any outcome is computed

regimeReviewInput.downloadRule: The execution workflow downloads this exact artifact (name, run id, artifact id and archive digest checked through the Actions API before download) and verifies the input identity before any outcome is computed.
regimeReviewInput.krxCacheNote: Pinned provenance. The daily KRX market-value files are covered byte-for-byte by the input identity.

inputs.rule: the exact immutable bytes the sealed studies read; the preserved raw-input artifact is pinned by name, run, id, archive digest and identity

lifecycle.executionLock: refs/tags/kr-integrated-alpha-portfolio-v1-execution-lock plus -<specSha256>; any existing ref under the prefix refuses; never moved or deleted
lifecycle.failureAfterLock: consumes the study permanently; never retried; the attempt artifact is preserved under -attempt-<runId>

never: change or reformat a result byte

sequence: signal-time feature assembly and the registered depth / ranking gates (can stop before anything is spent)
no committed result, marker or manifest
no execution lock under the study prefix
six paths x three cost stresses
automatic seal: verify run, artifact digest, file list, manifest, marker, spec and lock refs

marketLayer.application: a pure scale of the held book (drifted proportions kept, no new name, no swap), re-expressed at multiplier 1, renormalised to at most 1, times the new target; executed by the same sealed execute_rebalance as every other trade (ADV caps, partial fills, costs)
marketLayer.atAnchors: the multiplier in force scales the freshly sized base weights of that anchor's underlying decision
marketLayer.c1Status: SHADOW_CHALLENGER: the sealed model's formal non-nomination of C1 is preserved; this study judges C0 and C1 separately and promotes neither
marketLayer.missingState: the sealed hold rule (hold the previous target; undefined at the first decision is refused)
marketLayer.role: RISK OVERLAY ONLY: never changes eligibility or order. The identical underlying S or I+S book is built first and the already-selected book is scaled
marketLayer.timing: weekly decision at the calendar week-end close; trade at the NEXT KR session's close, only when the multiplier changes
marketLayer.unchanged: states, thresholds, windows, lags, missing-state hold rule, decision cadence, multiplier tables and timing are the sealed model's functions called directly

membership.limitation: 22 terminal common securities have no historical industry; most classified name-dates rest on a no-change reconstruction; not PIT exact

metrics.annualisation: calendar years (days / 365.2425) for returns; 252 sessions for volatility
metrics.overlap: daily path statistics; rolling windows overlap and are descriptive; no significance test; no multiplicity correction

anchors.signal: the last weekly KR signal strictly before the anchor

cash.sharpeSortino: NOT REPORTED: a risk-free assumption would have to be defended and none is claimed

costs.semantics: assumptions for every date, not statutory schedules; stress runs are descriptive

portfolio.executionQuote: an observed positive-volume quote at the execution close is required; otherwise the order is deferred (no fictitious fill)
portfolio.futureInformation: none: every score, state and decision is computed from information at or before the signal date
portfolio.inheritedFrom: kr-model-overlay-portfolio-v1 (values compared with the sealed spec on every load)
portfolio.sizing: inverse downside-volatility proportional water-fill under the 30% single-name cap and the 1% ADV capacity cap (kr_concentrated_portfolio.size); residual cash
portfolio.unresolvedTerminalEconomics: a held name with no observed close, no observed zero-volume quote and no terminal economics blocks THAT architecture's path (complete: false); no survivor or successor is substituted and no name silently disappears

priors.rule: every prior sealed study is pinned byte-for-byte; none is rerun, re-thresholded, reinterpreted or altered; the component studies motivated this architecture and are the reason every historical number here is development evidence

rules: one immutable receipt per future decision date, appended before the execution-session close

every input identity, the industry membership used, the registered feature values, the three scores, the eligible names, both underlying books, the C0 and C1 states and multipliers and all six target portfolios are recorded; no future outcome exists at creation
the six targets are derived as underlying x multiplier, never accepted from the caller
append-only JSON Lines; a duplicate key, an out-of-order date, a changed spec or an altered earlier row refuses the append
a receipt is evaluated only after its horizon has matured; no historical receipt is rewritten
historical development results and prospective receipts are separate evidence classes and are never pooled
prospective.status: DESIGNED_NOT_RUNNING: no receipt is written and no schedule exists in this change

question: Which fixed combination of the sealed Market, Industry and Stock components is worth recording prospectively: S, S+M0, S+M1, I+S, I+S+M0 or I+S+M1?

eligibility.depthRule: every rebalance anchor must leave at least the minimum eligible stocks for the S book and for the I+S book, otherwise the run stops BEFORE the lock (signal-time fact; spends nothing). 0-5 holdings remain valid when executability leaves fewer.
eligibility.tradable: observed positive volume and trading value at the signal close

excludedFromPrimaryScore.logAdv60: liquidity is investability (ADV60 floor), never alpha
excludedFromPrimaryScore.momentum121: stock momentum is an industry-layer / catalyst question, not part of the stock score
excludedFromPrimaryScore.negativeAccrualsToAssets: quality family not in the registered score
excludedFromPrimaryScore.netIncomeToAssets: quality family not in the registered score
excludedFromPrimaryScore.ocfImprovementToAssets: descriptive only in the sealed anatomy; not a primary score input
excludedFromPrimaryScore.ocfToAssets: quality family not in the registered score
excludedFromPrimaryScore.ocfYieldProxy: not part of the registered VALUE_SCORE
excludedFromPrimaryScore.relative126: stock momentum is an industry-layer / catalyst question, not part of the stock score

stockLayer.peerGroup: the frozen PIT industry membership (kr-industry-membership-foundation-v4, 14 groups) used ONLY as the peer group; at least 5 classified members
stockLayer.percentile: kr_stock_within_industry_anatomy.within_industry_percentiles: average-rank (r - 0.5) / n among the finite values of the SAME signal date and the stock's own industry; at least 5 finite values or NaN; ties share one percentile; past-only; fixed before any outcome

riskScore.meaning: higher = calmer (negative annualised downside semideviation over 126 sessions)

stockLayer.role: ALWAYS ON and identical in all six architectures: orders eligible stocks by cheapness and calm WITHIN their own industry

stockScore.rule: equal-weight mean of VALUE_SCORE and the within-industry percentile of negativeDownsideVol126; requires every primary component; higher = more attractive

valueScore.neverSubstituted: a missing component makes VALUE_SCORE missing; one component is never used for the other
valueScore.rule: mean of the within-industry percentile ranks; BOTH components must be finite
